ideas.title: 3 phone tips for festive light photos
ideas.why: The Joburg Zoo Festival of Lights opens this week, and a quick useful tip reel is the kind people send to friends before they go, which is the strongest reach signal right now.

hooks.text: Your Christmas light photos look blurry? Fix it in 3 taps.
Stop using flash at the Festival of Lights.
Send this to whoever's taking the photos this December.

beats.say: Bad blurry, flash-blown photo of festive lights, big red X
Tip 1: flash off, tap your subject and slide exposure down a little
Tip 2: hold the phone with both hands against your chest or lean on a railing
Tip 3: stand your people close to the lights so the glow lights their faces
Before and after side by side. Say: Want proper photos? That's what we do in Joburg.

ideas.onScreen:
Flash OFF
Tap the face, slide exposure down
Brace the phone
Stand close to the lights
Save this for December ✨
shots: Any festive lights in Joburg (a mall display, a street, your own house lights)
Phone screen recording of the exposure slider
One before and after pair shot on your phone
ideas.caption:
Flash off is tip number one, trust us ✨

Three quick fixes for festive light photos on your phone: turn the flash off, tap the face and slide the exposure down, and stand your people close to the lights so the glow does the work.

Send this to the friend who always takes the group photo.

And if you'd rather just be in the photos, we're on 068 690 1120 or the website.
